messages:
Alex: Quick check — are we still on for the tiny holiday thing in the lounge tomorrow at 4? low-key, snacks, maybe a meme exchange :santa:
Priya: Yes! I'll bring my famous (questionable) ginger-molasses cookies :cookie:
Jonah: I'll bring non-dairy hot chocolate. Also, can we do a 2-item challenge? bring two random mini-things to swap, no price limit haha :laughing:
Lina: Love the swap idea. Can we make one of the items something goofy-only? no socks allowed :stuck_out_tongue: 
Tess: I vote for a theme — 'office knickknack renaissance'. Also, can we put a tiny label with your name so we know who to blame for glitter? :sparkles:
Alex: Yes label or risk mysterious glittering of keyboards. Also bringing a 5-min playlist — drop whimsy tracks below and I'll stitch.
Priya: dropping: 'All I Want for Christmas Is You (ukulele cover)' and 'Jingle Bell Rock (kazoo remix)' :notes:
Jonah: adding 'Silent Night (synthwave edit)' and 'Frosty The Snowman (chipmunk tempo)'. This is now officially cursed. :grimacing:
Lina: calendar-bot: can you add the event and make it public?
calendar-bot: Event created: "Lounge Micro-Holiday Swap" — Tomorrow 4:00 PM — 30 min — Attendees: Alex, Priya, Jonah, Lina, Tess
Tess: tiny PSA — if you're bringing food, please label allergens. I have a severe nut allergy so tyvm.
Alex: noted. Priya will add allergen labels to cookies. Priya: will do! also bringing napkins and a tiny fire extinguisher just in case of over-enthusiastic candle use :fire_extinguisher:
Jonah: Can we have a tiny meme contest? winner gets honorary bragging rights and a mini tinsel crown. Vote will be by applause and duck-typed emoji reactions.
Lina: I'm in. I'll bring a paper crown.
Tess: Can I nominate 'Jonah's synthwave Silent Night' as a category? :joy:
Alex: Agenda set: snacks, swap, meme contest, 5-min curated playlist, allergy-safe labels. See y'all tomorrow! :party_popper:
Priya: Can't wait :heart:
Jonah: Bringing kazoo. Prepare yourselves. :kissing_heart:
